verdict.rationale: Portability is only implied. The wallets are non-custodial and user-owned with onchain enforcement, the docs claim you can "switch providers without migrations," and wallet webhooks mention "signer exports," which suggests keys and onchain assets can leave the platform. Missing for 10: any documented bulk data export, any export of account, order or transaction data in open formats (CSV/JSON), a documented exit or migration procedure, and independent corroboration.
